{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the counts of -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_count}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_count = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {duplicate_count}")

# Check if there are multiple sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_counts = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
retested_patients = sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].count()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (retested): {retested_patients}")

# Show a few rows with -999 to confirm
print("\nFirst few rows with biomarker_baseline == -999:")
print(data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].head())"}
